objective: Fact-check three things for a Helix-style Rust editor (termina 0.3 + possible tokio): (1) Which popular LSP language servers support non-stdio transports (unix socket or TCP) in addition to stdio? Check specifically: rust-analyzer, typescript-language-server, clangd, pyright/pylsp, gopls. For each state the transport options (e.g. rust-analyzer --socket/--port?). (2) Does termina (helix-editor/termina, 0.3.x) have any async/tokio integration (event-stream feature, async reader), or is it strictly synchronous poll/read? (3) How does Helix bridge termina's synchronous event reading into its tokio event loop (helix-term/src/application.rs) — briefly, what mechanism (blocking task + channel, spawn_blocking, etc.)? Cite primary sources (GitHub, docs.rs, crates.io). Keep the brief under 400 words, bullet format.
